## Learning route

1. Inspect a USB power bank and automotive fuse-panel branch as real systems.
2. Study a simplified blade-fuse cutaway.
3. Identify source, conductors, control, protection, and load.
4. Read the proper series schematic.
5. Complete a GUESS current and power calculation.
6. Enter the exact Casio sequence and preserve Ans.
7. Verify meter placement and readings in Tinkercad.
8. Build and measure the protected low-voltage circuit.
9. Diagnose a teacher-approved open fault.
10. Reflect on evidence, limits, and next steps.

## Safety boundary

Use protected extra-low voltage, a current-limited source, correctly rated conductors and components, and teacher approval before energizing. Never connect classroom breadboards or meters to mains voltage. Never use resistance or continuity mode on an energized circuit.
